scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.cutover:verify: pnpm --filter @notes/api build && pnpm --filter @notes/worker build && pnpm --filter @notes/db build && node packages/db/dist/verify-cutover-rollback.js
scripts.files:verify-backup-restore: docker build --target db-runtime --tag notes-v2-db:local --file infra/compose/Dockerfile . && docker run --rm --network notes-v2_default --env-file infra/compose/.env --env OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT=http://object-storage:9000 notes-v2-db:local node dist/verify-object-backup-restore.js
scripts.files:verify: docker build --target db-runtime --tag notes-v2-db:local --file infra/compose/Dockerfile . && docker run --rm --network notes-v2_default --env-file infra/compose/.env --env POSTGRES_HOST=postgres --env OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT=http://object-storage:9000 notes-v2-db:local node dist/migrate-files.js --verify-only
scripts.integrations:verify: pnpm --filter @notes/api verify:integrations && pnpm --filter @notes/worker exec vitest run src/integration-events.test.ts
